name: Subsistence
body:
Subsistence (Ex)
Source Ultimate Magic pg. 33
You can survive on very little food or water while helping others survive in harsh climates. When determining how long you can withstand starvation and thirst, including checks to avoid nonlethal damage, treat your Constitution score as though it were 10 points higher. Additionally, you gain a bonus equal to one half your druid level (minimum 1) on Survival checks in dry hills or desert terrain.
